history_scope: Available careers of current published NBA roster identities, 2003-04 onward; original master retained.
phase_policy: Regular Season, Playoffs, Play-In separately labeled; exhibitions and Cup finals excluded.
limits: Coverage is the published source inventory, not an independently reconciled all-NBA game inventory.
Only current 2026-27 roster identities in the published asset are backfilled; a never-listed/injured/unsigned player can be absent.
No claim of complete careers: source omissions and failed full-game validations are explicitly recorded.
Regular season, playoffs and play-in remain separate; Cup championships and All-Star/exhibitions excluded.
Original master rows always win conflicts; this includes unknown game status and differing statistics until reviewed.
Historical pregame injuries, expected starters, tentative defenders, prop offers and payouts cannot be recovered from box scores.
Source publication dates and covered game dates are distinct. Current source ends 2026-11-02.
Historical final values include later scorer corrections; original point-in-time source versions are not reconstructed.

repair_summary.source: Independent ESPN event summaries; identity, season, phase and full team score reconciliation checked.
repair_summary.source_publication_date: Not reported; actual retrieval times retained separately.
